department: Department of Chemistry (Guelph-Waterloo Centre for Graduate Work in Chemistry and Biochemistry)

deadline.value: International applicants apply by February 1, 2027 for Fall entry; apply at least nine months ahead because of study permits and supervisor availability.
deadline.quote: International: Fall (September): February 1, 2027 | International applicants are encouraged to apply at least nine months in advance of their start date, and all applicants are advised to apply as early as possible due to supervisor availability.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE – The GRE and the GRE subject area test in chemistry and/or biochemistry are not required.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE – The GRE and the GRE subject area test in chemistry and/or biochemistry are not required.

supervisor.value: Applications go to faculty members; you are admitted only if a faculty member is interested in taking you, so contact faculty in your area.
supervisor.quote: Contact GWC2 Faculty members in the research areas you are interested. | The faculty members, if interested, will contact the applicant to ascertain if they are a good fit for their research program. If the faculty members are not interested, the applicant is informed that GWC2 is unable to offer the applicant a place in our graduate program.

funding.value: Full-time thesis students without outside funding are typically fully funded through scholarships, TA and RA positions.
funding.quote: Full funding is typically provided for full-time, thesis-based students (who do not receive external funding) through a combination of scholarships, teaching assistantships, and/or research assistantships.

entry_route.value: An MSc is normally needed; direct PhD entry from a BSc is possible with an overall A standing.
entry_route.quote: In general, an applicant must possess the qualifications listed for the MSc program, together with a Master of Science degree comparable to those awarded by North American universities | However, direct admission to the PhD program is available to applicants with an overall A standing in an Honours B.Sc. degree.

notes: Joint graduate centre with the University of Waterloo; one application covers both.
